acute.definition: Coming on quickly and lasting a short time, usually days.
acute.example: This is an acute episode, and it started yesterday.

code_switching.definition: Moving between two languages, or two varieties of one language, inside a single conversation.
code_switching.example: Code-switching between English and Tamil is normal in Chennai offices.

spec_assumption.definition: Something a plan takes as true without checking it.
spec_assumption.example: The hidden assumption is that the machine will be ready on the first day.

vitamin.definition: A tiny helper in food that keeps your body working well. Fruit has plenty of vitamins.
vitamin.example: One orange gives me lots of vitamin C.
